composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-114a "BILGE SYSTEM") wires the bilge system: the main bilge pump, the five Burkert electric-actuated bilge valves (one per compartment: eng.room valve stations wired identically but feeding Port Laz/Stbd Laz/Aft/Eng.Room/Fwd/Sail Locker regions), the compartment bilge-level switches, and the main-panel/PC-card monitoring & alarm loop tying it all to the vessel control panel and ONYX. Evidence: title block "BILGE SYSTEM"; load labels "BILGE VALVES Q13 10A"; valve boxes labelled "BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE" repeated per station; compartment switch labels PORT/STBD LAZARETTE, AFT, ENG.ROOM, FWD BILGE, SAIL LOCKER; MAIN BILGE PUMP motor top-right; MAIN PANEL/PLUG C and PC CARD sections referencing S13/S20-24 and open/closed indicator lamps per compartment.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Motor labelled 'MAIN BILGE PUMP' top-right of sheet, fed via F3 60A / SW8 / SO 6 relay and T/S S terminals 13/14/15 exactly as previously engineer-traced (established fact). This sheet redraws the same local-pump-switch / relay / terminal loop already recorded on the node; only the physical valve-station wiring below is new.

functions.label: Bilge pump run command (multi-source activation)
functions.what_it_does: Energises the main bilge pump motor's solenoid contactor coil so the pump runs; the coil can be closed from any of several sources feeding into the same T/S S / SO 6 loop.

flow_scenarios.path: +24V service battery -> F3 60A -> SW8 -> SO6 coil -> T/S S terminals 13/14/15 -> local pump switch or remote command -> pump motor contactor -> MAIN BILGE PUMP motor -> case/earth return
LOCAL PUMP SW (T/S S pins 1/2, terminals 13/14) closes the T/S S loop -> SO6/contactor -> pump runs
MAIN PANEL switch via Plug C pins 6/7 closes the same T/S S loop -> pump runs (established fact, not re-walked on this sheet)
ONYX remote via XA11 cable 7 into terminal 50, switched through relay Re6 -> closes loop -> pump runs (established fact)

key_components: T/S S terminal strip (13/14/15, terminal 13 fused)
functions.dry_data: 24V DC, F3 60A supply fuse, SW8 isolator switch
functions.sheet_region: top-left (T/S S / SO6) and top-right (pump motor), approx bbox [0,0]-[0.45,0.2] and [0.82,0.06]-[0.92,0.13]

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Five repeated 'BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE' motorised valve stations (electric actuators) fed via relays Re1-Re5 off breaker 'BILGE VALVES Q13 10A' and T/S B / T/S C terminal strips, matching the register's Burkert electric rotary actuator bilge valves. Each station's OPEN/CLOSE switch pair and motor is a control loop for one compartment's bilge suction valve.

functions.label: Compartment bilge valve OPEN/CLOSE control (5 stations: Port/Stbd Laz, Aft, Eng.Room, Fwd, Sail Locker feed lines)
functions.what_it_does: Drives the electric rotary actuator on each compartment's bilge suction valve open or closed, selecting which compartment is connected to the bilge manifold/pump suction.

flow_scenarios.path: Q13 10A breaker -> T/S B terminal (8/9/10/etc, one per station) -> Re(n) relay contact -> T/S C terminal pair -> valve actuator motor -> valve body
OPEN switch contact -> T/S C terminal (e.g. 7,16,24,32,40) -> valve actuator motor [2] -> valve drives open
CLOSE switch contact -> T/S C terminal (e.g. 8,17,25,33,41) -> valve actuator motor [3] -> valve drives closed
Re(n) relay contact -> XA40 or XA10 status terminals (e.g. XA40<14>,<12>,<16>; XA10<06>,<04>,<02>) -> ONYX monitoring loom (status only, per engineer note XA40/XA10 are STATUS taps)

key_components: T/S B terminal strip (supply distribution to relays)
T/S C terminal strip (OPEN/CLOSE contacts + motor + status taps, terminals 1-50)
OPEN/CLOSE manual contact pairs per station
functions.dry_data: Fed via BILGE VALVES Q13 10A breaker, 24V DC; electric rotary actuator (Burkert per register) — INCOMPLETE: positive/feed side of each valve motor coil not traced on this sheet (only relay-contact/T/S C return side walked)
functions.sheet_region: center column, T/S B / Re1-6 relay bank and T/S C terminal strip, bbox approx [0.16,0.26]-[0.46,0.77]

uncertainties: Each valve station's positive/feed supply line into the actuator motor coil is not traced end-to-end on this sheet (only the relay-contact / T/S C return side is drawn clearly) — engineer should confirm feed routing at inspection.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Compartment bilge level switches (no dedicated node — see uncertainty)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Six bilge-level switches (Port Laz, Stbd Laz, Aft, Eng.Room, Fwd, Sail Locker) are drawn as small boxes labelled 'BILGE SW' feeding status lines toward the valve stations and toward Main Panel PC Card indicators. The register has no dedicated bilge-level-sensor node (520-vega-bilge-level-sensors exists under a different top-level index root not in this vessel's register list); closest fitting register entries (520-bilge-valves, 520-main-bilge-pump) don't match a level-switch identity. Recording here as their own functional group pending a fitting node.

functions.what_it_does: Each compartment switch (Port Laz, Stbd Laz, Aft, Eng.Room, Fwd, Sail Locker) senses bilge water level in its own compartment and reports status toward the monitoring/indicator chain.

flow_scenarios.path: compartment BILGE SW (+/- leads) -> feed line toward valve station tap -> onward to Main Panel PC Card open/closed indicator lamp for that compartment

key_components: BILGE SW per compartment (6 total: Port Laz, Stbd Laz, Aft, Eng.Room, Fwd, Sail Locker)

For each compartment switch only two of its three leads (a labelled +/- pair) could be confidently walked; the third lead (arrow-marked) is unresolved on this sheet.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Vessel Control Panel — Main Panel bilge section (641-vessel-control-panel)

functions.what_it_does: Provides operator pushbuttons/switches at the main panel to command the bilge pump and to select/monitor which compartment valve is open, mirrored back through Plug C wiring to the bilge system relay/terminal loop.

S13 BILGE PUMP SW -> Plug C pins 6/7 -> bilge pump T/S S loop (feeds pump run function on 520-main-bilge-pump, per established engineer fact)
S20/S21/S22/S23/S24 <-> Plug C pins 1-5 <-> T/S C terminals (e.g. 47, 50, 23) tied to valve stations on 520-bilge-valves

infrastructure.system_name: T/S B / Relay bank (Re1-Re6) / T/S C terminal distribution
facts: T/S B terminal strip distributes the BILGE VALVES Q13 10A breaker feed to relay contacts Re1-Re6 (one relay per valve/pump station).
T/S C terminal strip (terminals 1-50) carries OPEN/CLOSE switch contacts, valve motor leads, and XA40/XA10/XA11 status taps for all five valve stations plus the ONYX/main-panel bilge pump loop.
XA40 and XA10 tags are STATUS taps out of the relay contacts toward ONYX monitoring (confirmed by prior engineer red-pen fact on 520-main-bilge-pump), not activation inputs.
Terminal 13 on T/S S carries a built-in replaceable fuse (troubleshooting culprit).

infrastructure.system_name: Main Panel Plug C / Plug D terminal strips
facts: Plug C (12 pins) carries compartment switch signals (S20-S24, S13) between the bilge valve station wiring and the Main Panel.
Plug D (12 pins) carries the Main Panel PC Card's open/closed indicator wiring to/from the valve station taps.
